person_note: The novel sustains two base-person modes: a participating communal first-person-plural voice in recurring 'The Cobblestone Telegraph' sections and third-person limited narration elsewhere. The authorized excerpt directly displays both modes, while a Tier C whole-book guide identifies the recurring first-plural chapters alongside the third-person narration. These are recurring structural sections rather than a brief framing exception, so ALTERNATING remains appropriate. Confidence is medium because the Goodreads set does not expose both modes and the whole-book structural source is Tier C.
